content:
TEMPTATION ||| Tighten my grip on The Answer, feeling its weight pulse. ||| "I’ll show them my truth, if you dare to watch."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his. ||| "This ritual isn’t a game, and I won’t be a pawn."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, a flicker of vulnerability in my eyes. ||| "I thought you’d understand how much this means to me."  
REVERSAL ||| Pivot to face Seren, energy shifting in the room. ||| "I will decide what happens next; I will not be judged."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, eyes darting between them, heart racing. |||
